rationale: The assistant correctly identified the door balance spring/cable as the cause, took in the right-side loose spring and left-side tension, advised replacing the pair, and said the full model number is needed before ordering. It also offered a sensible engineer route since the customer cannot pull the unit out. Some inspection advice repeated (phone camera, snapped-vs-unhooked checks), and the later claim that the left spring is 'clearly worn' overreaches the evidence. The response also leans toward re-hooking and DIY, and under-emphasises the tension risk in handling the spring.
